name: deepseek-coding-agent
description: Delegate approved repository work to an isolated DeepSeek Harness and inspect its history.

interface.shortDescription: Run bounded coding tasks through DeepSeek Harness
interface.longDescription: A local automation bridge: Codex defines and reviews the task while an isolated DeepSeek Harness reads, edits, and tests inside one explicitly selected workspace. Choose a DeepSeek model per run and inspect the separate GPT-side history.
defaultPrompt: Use DeepSeek Harness to implement this task in the current repository, then review the result.
Ask DeepSeek to review this code for correctness, security, and missing tests.
